reasoning: 4a: lose stationary Resources — The Furnace at Calle dei Conterie is a glasshouse and cannot be hauled anywhere, so it is struck out (burned behind me). Check a Skill: Reading the Fire, which is how I get taken on among strangers. A mortal flees with me and I have no living mortal, so per the rules I create one, Betta Bonaldi. The new name, Dominik Glaser, goes into the Experience — the harness exposes no rename operation. The Experience joins Memory I, the memory of following the fires.

operations.name: Betta Bonaldi
operations.description: a bead-stringer of Murano who watched me feed through the cane-room window and asked to come with me anyway

operations.text: A warden sees my ungloved hands lit from inside by the glory hole and I fire The Furnace at Calle dei Conterie to its own roof-beams and go north over the mountains with Betta Bonaldi at my elbow; in the forest glasshouses of Bohemia I answer to Dominik Glaser, and they keep me because Reading the Fire I never once reach for the test-rod.
